subject: Follow-up on your FlexiFunnels support call – domain connection
body_text:
Hi Arjun,

Thank you for speaking with us. You reached out because your domain was not connecting and your funnel opened only on the FlexiFunnels link.

What we completed during the call:
- Following our guidance, you deleted the old A record in your GoDaddy DNS settings and added a CNAME record (name www, with the value shown in your FlexiFunnels domain settings), saving both.
- Your domain now shows as connected in FlexiFunnels, and your funnel opens on it.

What we discussed:
- We explained that the SSL padlock can take a little time to appear.

What you need to do next:
1. Check whether the SSL padlock has appeared the morning after our call, and let us know if it has not.

You can rewatch our call here: https://fathom.video/share/EXAMPLE-F2

If anything is unclear, just reply to this email.

Warm regards,
Sameer
FlexiFunnels Support
